description: The plot illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three different values. The x-axis is labeled “Question Popularity” and has a linear scale ranging from 5 to 25, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Values” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.55 to 1.00, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents “Accuracy” and begins at approximately 0.67 at a question popularity of 5, rises to approximately 0.83 at a question popularity of 10, declines to approximately 0.74 at a question popularity of 15, and ends at approximately 0.92 at a question popularity of 25. A green line, marked with triangular data points, represents “Confidence” and begins at approximately 0.93 at a question popularity of 5, rises to approximately 0.98 at a question popularity of 10, declines to approximately 0.95 at a question popularity of 15, and ends at approximately 0.97 at a question popularity of 25. A red line, marked with square data points, represents “Alignment” and begins at approximately 0.72 at a question popularity of 5, declines to approximately 0.68 at a question popularity of 10, rises to approximately 0.86 at a question popularity of 15, and ends at approximately 0.88 at a question popularity of 25.
